thread:
nina: FYI sales asked for a lightweight chargeback view: per-route currency cost + link-to-traces for audits. timeline: "pilot in ~6 weeks".

owen: quick clarifying q  - realtime vs daily? they said daily is fine to start.

li: proposal: (1) add stable route_id & tenant_id span tags; (2) emit request token_estimate for batch prorating; (3) pre-aggregate daily token counts per route; (4) sampled trace link UI.

marco: sampling plan: index all error traces + traces with latency > p95 + 0.05% uniform sample for normals. keeps trace storage controlled.

own: tradeoffs: full per-request indexing gives perfect accuracy but ~x10 storage/query cost. prefer hybrid for MVP.

nina: UX ask from customers: clickable cost row -> list of sampled traces (time + latency + error flag) + ability to filter by caller id. also CSV export for accounting.

li: note on batching: attribute token cost by prorating using token_estimate. we can compute token_estimate in runtime with ~0.2% CPU overhead.

marco: ops: default hybrid sampling and opt-in toggle for full indexing on a per-customer basis. add quota guard to avoid runaway storage.

own: launch criteria draft: 1) Console shows per-route daily currency cost + 7-day sparkline, 2) each route/day row links to sampled traces, 3) spans include route_id/tenant_id/token_estimate, 4) CSV export for date range, 5) reconciliation job produces "reconciled" overnight values.

nina: roadmap ask: ship MVP in 6 weeks as a focused eng sprint (2 backend, 1 analytics, 1 frontend). then iterate based on beta feedback.

li: action items: nina - beta customers list & comms; owen - RFC for header/tag propagation + token counter; marco - sampling config + staging deploy; li - pre-agg pipeline prototype + reconciliation job; opsbot - schedule staging deploy when ready.

opsbot: scheduled staging deploy for config `telemetry.sampling=hybrid-0.05-error-p95` at 2024-07-12T02:00Z.
